caption: The drawing depicts a folded quilt with a distinct, segmented design. The left portion of the quilt features a pattern of concentric squares composed of alternating strips of fabric in various colors including black, brown, green, red, orange, yellow, and pink, arranged in a log cabin style. The right portion, forming a border, shows a beige background decorated with green vine and leaf appliqués alongside clusters of grapes in shades of dark purple, red, and green, with additional embroidery in a brownish thread representing tendrils. The overall composition emphasizes a contrast between the geometric, multicolored sections and the organic, nature-themed border. The drawing is rendered on a neutral background and the artist's name, "CHARLOTTE ANGUI," is written near the bottom right corner.
title: Log Cabin Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
